validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="inc"><assign location="count" expr="$count + 1"/></transition>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `count` selects a child element named `count`, not the variable `$count`
notes: the context node of every XPath expression is `<datamodel>`, whose children are `<data id="…">` elements and the system variables; assigning to a location that selects no node raises `error.execution`
diagnostics.help: `<data id="count">` is bound to the variable `$count`; a bare name is a relative path from `<datamodel>`
